interface.signature: def canFinish(n: int, prerequisites: List[List[int]]) -> bool

preconditions.description: The number of courses n must be non-negative.

preconditions.expression: all(isinstance(prereq, list) and len(prereq) == 2 for prereq in prerequisites)
preconditions.description: Each prerequisite must be a list of exactly two integers.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= prereq[0] < n and 0 <= prereq[1] < n for prereq in prerequisites)
preconditions.description: Each course in the prerequisites must be a valid course index within the range of 0 to n-1.

postconditions.expression: stdout == 'true' if canFinish(n, prerequisites) else stdout == 'false'
postconditions.description: The output must be 'true' if it is possible to finish all courses, otherwise 'false'.
